newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Reuters photographer wins Lauda Air Australian GP award.
newsitem.headline: Reuters photographer wins Lauda Air Australian GP award.

text.p: A photograph taken at the 1997 Australian Formula One Grand Prix has taken out first prize in the Lauda Air 1997 Motor Racing Press Photographers Award.

The winning picture was taken by Sydney-based Reuters photographer David Gray who earns a special trophy and a trip for two people flying with Lauda Air to Vienna to attend the Austrian Grand Prix in September.
The shot, widely used in Australian newspapers, showed Scotland's David Coulthard celebrating his win with Michael Schumacher and a magnum of champagne on the podium at the Albert Park circuit.
The Lauda Air Motor Racing Press Photographers Award competition was open to all Australian-based professional news photographers and in its inaugural year attacted several hundred entries.
